class.name: GradientSkyMaterial4D
class.brief_description: A 4D sky material that generates a sky from a gradient of user-defined colors.
class.description: A procedural 4D sky based on simple color gradients. It supports up to four [DirectionalLight4D] nodes as suns and evaluates their directions in 4D, allowing a sun to move out of the currently viewed 3D cross-section. Its properties closely match [ProceduralSkyMaterial], excluding panorama-based sky cover and other options that do not have a direct 4D equivalent.

members.member: Color at the bottom of the sky, also known as the nadir.

How quickly the [member horizon_color] fades into the [member bottom_color]. A curve value of 1.0 is a linear transition. Values between 0.0 and 1.0 make the bottom color more dominant, while values between 1.0 and infinity make the horizon color more dominant.
Color at the horizon between the top and bottom colors.
The angular distance from a [DirectionalLight4D] at which it begins fading into the background sky, in degrees.
How quickly each sun fades between its edge and [member sun_angle_max].
Color at the top of the sky, also known as the zenith.

How quickly the [member horizon_color] fades into the [member top_color]. A curve value of 1.0 is a linear transition. Values between 0.0 and 1.0 make the top color more dominant, while values between 1.0 and infinity make the horizon color more dominant.
